    local dist, thing = math.huge
    for i, v in next, game:GetService("Workspace").Drops:GetChildren() do
        if v:IsA("Model") then
            local mag =
                (game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position - v.Base.Position).magnitude
